sendTextWhisp.heading: Send a Text Whisp
sendTextWhisp.description: A short, anonymous note to any phone number — not just people already on Blind Whisper.
sendTextWhisp.privacyReminder: Avoid sharing anything that could identify you, unless you want to — this stays anonymous unless you choose to reveal yourself.
sendTextWhisp.messagePlaceholder: Write something kind, honest, or brave...
sendTextWhisp.recipientDisclosure: If they're already on Blind Whisper, it delivers instantly in-app. If not, they'll get a text with a link to read it — and can sign up to reply the same way.

textWhispDetail.deleteDialogDescription: This removes it from your Text Whisps. This can't be undone from your side.
textWhispDetail.revealAcceptedMessage: They accepted! You can now tell them who you are — send a reply above.
textWhispDetail.revealAskMessage: The person who sent you this wants to reveal who they are. Allow it?
textWhispDetail.revealPermissionNote: This only grants permission — they'll still have to tell you who they are.

textWhispsList.heading: Text Whisps
textWhispsList.description: Short, anonymous notes between you and other Blind Whisper people — a separate thing from your video Whisps.

publicTextWhisp.notFound: This Text Whisp could not be found — the link may have expired or is no longer valid.
publicTextWhisp.receivedHeading: You've received an anonymous Text Whisp
publicTextWhisp.wantToReplyDescription: Sign up free to reply the same way — anonymous, fold-and-unfurl included.
publicTextWhisp.sendYourOwnPrefix: Send an anonymous Text Whisp of your own —
publicTextWhisp.revealRequestedMessage: Whoever sent this wants to reveal themselves.
publicTextWhisp.revealSignUpNote: Sign up free to accept or decline.
publicTextWhisp.poweredBySuffix: — send what matters, without the awkward part.
